description: A test bot that plays one of the user's own multiplayer games, so a game can be tested alone: action "join" seats a bot in an open room of the project (roomId from r3_game_rooms, or the room's invite code) and answers a botId, the seat, the players and the game state; "send" sends a message as the bot (its type and data, exactly what the game's scripts send); "events" returns what the bot heard since the last call (room events, refusals, leaving); "leave" takes the bot out. The other players see the seat as a bot. Never a quick match, a new room or a money room. At most 3 bots at once; a bot not driven for 10 minutes leaves. Changes nothing saved. Needs the editor:run right.

botId.description: send / events / leave: the botId join answered.

code.description: join: the room's invite code (8 letters and digits); or give roomId.

name.description: join: the name the other players see (default "Bot").

roomId.description: join: the room id (r3_game_rooms); or give code.

type.description: send: the message type the game expects (a short identifier).

name: r3_game_bot
title: Play a game as a test bot
